ranges.name: geometry_le_scale
ranges.role: Proof unchanged, restored publicly in the new budget namespace.
ranges.original:
private theorem geometry_le_scale {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) (hsigma : 0 < sigma) :
    d.U ≤ d.scale ∧ d.V ≤ d.scale ∧ d.Q1 ≤ d.scale ∧
      d.Q2 ≤ d.scale ∧ d.Q3 ≤ d.scale := by
  have hdKeep := hd
  obtain ⟨hU, hV, _hQ1, hQ2, hQ3, _, _, _, hg1, hg2, _⟩ := hdKeep
  have hX := one_le_scale hd
  have hUx : d.U ≤ d.scale := by unfold MediumAtom.scale; nlinarith
  have hVx : d.V ≤ d.scale := V_le_scale hd
  have hn : d.scale ^ (-sigma) ≤ 1 := by
    simpa only [Real.rpow_zero] using
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hX (by linarith : -sigma ≤ 0)
  have hQ1x : d.Q1 ≤ d.scale := by
    calc
      _ ≤ d.U * d.scale ^ (-sigma) := hg1.le
      _ ≤ d.U * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hn (by linarith)
      _ = d.U := mul_one _
      _ ≤ _ := hUx
  have hpow : d.scale ^ (1 - 8 * sigma) ≤ d.scale := by
    simpa only [Real.rpow_one] using
      Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hX (by linarith : 1 - 8 * sigma ≤ 1)
  have hU2 : 1 ≤ d.U ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hQ32 : 1 ≤ d.Q3 ^ 2 := by nlinarith
  have hprod : 1 ≤ d.U ^ 2 * d.Q3 ^ 2 := by
    calc
      1 = (1 : ℝ) * 1 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ d.U ^ 2 * d.Q3 ^ 2 := mul_le_mul hU2 hQ32 zero_le_one (sq_nonneg _)
  have hQ2x : d.Q2 ≤ d.scale := by
    calc
      _ = d.Q2 * 1 := by ring
      _ ≤ d.Q2 * (d.U ^ 2 * d.Q3 ^ 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hprod (by linarith)
      _ = d.U ^ 2 * d.Q2 * d.Q3 ^ 2 := by ring
      _ ≤ d.scale ^ (1 - 8 * sigma) := hg2.le
      _ ≤ _ := hpow
  have hprod2 : 1 ≤ d.U ^ 2 * d.Q2 := by
    calc
      1 = (1 : ℝ) * 1 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ d.U ^ 2 * d.Q2 := mul_le_mul hU2 hQ2 zero_le_one (sq_nonneg _)
  have hQ3x : d.Q3 ≤ d.scale := by
    calc
      _ ≤ d.Q3 ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      _ = 1 * d.Q3 ^ 2 := by ring
      _ ≤ (d.U ^ 2 * d.Q2) * d.Q3 ^ 2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hprod2 (sq_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ d.scale ^ (1 - 8 * sigma) := hg2.le
      _ ≤ _ := hpow
  exact ⟨hUx, hVx, hQ1x, hQ2x, hQ3x⟩

ranges.name: actual_smallSupported_smoothFiniteFrequency_log_payment
ranges.role: Source of the physical smoothing choice and cleanedAlphaAtom dictionary. This earlier theorem is not imported or asserted by this module.
ranges.original:
theorem actual_smallSupported_smoothFiniteFrequency_log_payment
    (B : ℕ) (sigma kappa c0 A eta : ℝ) (hsigma : 0 < sigma) (heta : 0 < eta) :
    ∃ x0 : ℝ, 1 < x0 ∧ ∀ d : MediumAtom,
      MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d → x0 ≤ d.scale →
        let e := d.cleanedAlphaAtom
        let Y := d.scale ^ (sigma / 4)
        let Z := d.scale ^ eta
        (∑ n ∈ d.betaCarrier, ‖d.beta n‖ ^ 2) *
          (∑ p ∈ d.primitiveFirstFactorCarrier, ‖d.gamma1 p‖ ^ 2) *
            ‖e.sharedSmallPairedSmallSupportedNonzero Y Y -
              e.sharedSmallPairedSmallSupportedNonzeroSmooth Y Y Z‖ ≤
                d.scale ^ 2 / (Real.log d.scale) ^ A := by

ranges.name: one_le_scale
ranges.original:
theorem one_le_scale
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) : 1 ≤ d.scale := by
  unfold MediumAtom.scale
  calc
    1 = (1 : ℝ) * 1 := by norm_num
    _ ≤ _ := mul_le_mul hd.1 hd.2.1 zero_le_one (by linarith [hd.1])

ranges.name: V_le_scale
ranges.original:
theorem V_le_scale
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) : d.V ≤ d.scale := by
  change d.V ≤ d.U * d.V
  exact le_mul_of_one_le_left (by linarith [hd.2.1]) hd.1

ranges.name: scaleB
ranges.original: def scaleB (e : MediumAtom) (delta l : ℕ) : ℝ := (l : ℝ)*e.U*e.Q3/delta

ranges.name: scaleC
ranges.original: def scaleC (e : MediumAtom) (D g l : ℕ) : ℝ := e.U*e.Q3*e.Q2/((g : ℝ)*l*D)

ranges.name: scaleB_pos_of_mem
ranges.role: Original fixed-slice positivity uses gcd membership. Our positive-index lemma leaves the fixedSlice membership transport as a separate obligation.
ranges.original:
/-- No delta>0 premise is added: actual membership itself supplies it. -/
private theorem scaleB_pos_of_mem (e : MediumAtom)
    (hN : 1 ≤ e.U) (hR : 1 ≤ e.Q3) (Yb Ys : ℝ) {D delta g l : ℕ}
    (hl : 0 < l) {o : OuterIndex} (ho : o ∈ fixedSlice e Yb Ys D delta g l) :
    0 < scaleB e delta l := by
  have hd := (mem_filter.mp ho).2.2.1
  have hrmem := (fixedSlice_facts e Yb Ys D delta g l ho).2.2.2.1
  have hr : 0 < o.2.1.1 := (factorCarrier_bounds hR hrmem).1
  have hdelta : 0 < delta := by rw [← hd]; exact Nat.gcd_pos_of_pos_left D hr
  have hNR : 0 < e.U := zero_lt_one.trans_le hN
  have hRR : 0 < e.Q3 := zero_lt_one.trans_le hR
  have hlR : (0 : ℝ) < l := by exact_mod_cast hl
  have hdR : (0 : ℝ) < delta := by exact_mod_cast hdelta
  dsimp [scaleB]
  positivity

ranges.name: scaleC_pos
ranges.role: Original positivity for positive D,g,l. New lemma derives positive lengths from MediumAdmissible.
ranges.original:
private theorem scaleC_pos (e : MediumAtom)
    (hN : 1 ≤ e.U) (hR : 1 ≤ e.Q3) (hS : 1 ≤ e.Q2)
    {D g l : ℕ} (hD : 0 < D) (hg : 0 < g) (hl : 0 < l) : 0 < scaleC e D g l := by
  have hNR : 0 < e.U := zero_lt_one.trans_le hN
  have hRR : 0 < e.Q3 := zero_lt_one.trans_le hR
  have hSR : 0 < e.Q2 := zero_lt_one.trans_le hS
  have hDR : (0 : ℝ) < D := by exact_mod_cast hD
  have hgR : (0 : ℝ) < g := by exact_mod_cast hg
  have hlR : (0 : ℝ) < l := by exact_mod_cast hl
  dsimp [scaleC]
  positivity

new_calculation: From MediumAdmissible and sigma>0, for every natural D,delta,g,l including zero, F≤x, C≤x³ and H≤65Zx⁵ for Z≥1. For Z=x^eta with eta>0, explicit finite cardinality gives C² rawLabelBudget≤202800 x^(19+2eta). All occurrences of Z here are the physical h cutoff multiplier.
scope: Bounds apply to an admissible atom e. Using this at the original e=d.cleanedAlphaAtom requires the cleaned admissibility dictionary. The earlier smoothing payment, the actual fixed-slice membership, outer Fourier and label summation, and the original signed row are separate arguments.
